title: Test plan
description: What suiterun generate --plan prints and every generator renders: the suites and cases the generated code declares, with their identifiers, tags and guards (test-plan.md). Five runtimes must print the same plan for the same inputs.

identifier.description: Letters and digits from the name, each word capitalised, never starting with a digit, with _<n> appended on a collision (test-plan.md, Identifiers).

file.description: Relative to the config's folder, forward slashes.

guardedBy.description: The actions offlineActions does not cover, sorted ordinally.

cases.description: File order; examples rows in row order.

name.description: The exact case name, which is the test's display name and what the session is called with.

outline.description: An examples row only: the case's own name.

row.description: An examples row only: its values, with their YAML types.
